summary: Renders a colored horizontal bar whose fill proportion and color depend on a normalized value for a vehicle corner. Guards on vehicle equality by comparing the +18580 field of the player vehicle (VehiclePtrArray[CurrentPlayerIndex]) with the same field of the current vehicle (VehiclePtrArray[CurrentVehicleIndex]). When equal, reads a per-corner value indexed by a1 (stride 1124 into a data region), normalizes it with (v - 0.75) * 4.0, clamps to [0,1], draws a fixed-color background bar, then draws a proportional fill bar whose color is chosen by the normalized level. When the vehicles differ, draws a full green bar.

operations.description: Vehicle equality check: compare the +18580 field of VehiclePtrArray[CurrentPlayerIndex] with the same field of VehiclePtrArray[CurrentVehicleIndex]. Equal vehicles take the value-driven bar path; different vehicles take the full-green-bar path.
Read the per-corner value indexed by a1 (stride 1124 into a data region) and normalize it: v = (value - 0.75) * 4.0.
Clamp the normalized value into [0.0, 1.0]: values below 0 are forced to 0, values above 1 are forced to 1.
Draw the background bar in a fixed dark color (-16777216) with the original dimensions via RenderDrawOperationWithClipping.
Only draw the fill bar when the normalized value is greater than 0.0; otherwise leave only the background.
Select the fill color from the normalized value: -16711936 when greater than 0.8, -256 when between 0.5 and 0.8, otherwise -65536.
Convert the scaled fill width with CRTFtol((double)a4 * v9).
Draw the proportional fill bar with the selected color and converted width via RenderDrawOperationWithClipping.
When the compared vehicles differ, draw a full bar in green (-16711936) via RenderDrawOperationWithClipping.
